name: Commerce Shipping Mondial Relay
description: Provides Mondial Relay pick-up-point shipping for Drupal Commerce.
project_description:
Integrates the Mondial Relay shipping widget with Drupal Commerce.

 Features 
 Provides basic integration of Mondial relay shipping solution adding shipping method and shipping pane with Mondial Relay widget .

 Instructions 
 
 Install the module and its dependencies 
 Add and configure shipping method with Mondial Relay plugin. Follow Mondial relay documentation for further informations on widget settings. 
 Add Mondial Relay shipping pane to you checkout flow 
 The Mondial Relay shipping pane needs shipping_information pane provided by commerce_shipping module to be present to work 
 
 Known issues 
 
 If you have multiple shipping methods, ajax does not refresh the mondial relay widget and does not show/hide widget. See https://www.drupal.org/project/commerce_shipping_mondial_relay/issues/3… to find a solution.
